item.title: PM Pressed, Teachers Strike Looms, Power Cuts Cost
item.ns0:title: PM Pressed, Teachers Strike Looms, Power Cuts Cost
item.description:
Tonight on Our News, Prime Minister Philip Davis fires back at tough questions during his Grand Bahama tour regarding alleged government links to a slain Abaco man. Tensions also boil over on the education front as the teachers' union president puts members on high alert for an imminent nationwide strike. Plus, local business owners speak out about the crippling financial losses caused by relentless power outages, while families of the tragic Independence Day plane crash receive a critical update that brings them one step closer to closure. We also have the details on the interception of more than 140 Haitian migrants near Great Inagua, and the exciting live reveal of a brand-new car winner.
